backupCopyAgentRequest.description: Only on explicit user request, reveal the native backup import or export button and wait for the user to click it and use the file dialog. Never clicks, chooses paths or receives backup bytes. Returns imported/exported/cancelled only after that host flow settles; imported does not prove reload/genesis completed. Export lets the user choose a complete encrypted archive or the v1 library subset; the user enters the password only in host UI. A final exported receipt does not identify which format was selected. Import accepts complete encrypted archives and the legacy v1 library subset. Complete archives require a password, host review of restore choices and any plugin consent, then explicit confirmation; successful restore requires reload, and recovery failures may also require reload. The v1 subset includes KV, books, collections, annotations and available original files, without complete event history, AI chats, memory, plugin documents or secrets; merging can overwrite records and failures can leave partial writes. Cancelling the wait cannot undo committed changes. No silent restore, guarantee of backup completeness or arbitrary file access.
